newsitem.title: NORWAY: Oil output at Saga's Vigdis rising daily.
newsitem.headline: Oil output at Saga's Vigdis rising daily.

text.p: Saga Petroleum ASA said on Friday crude production at the Vigdis development in the Norwegian North Sea was going to plan three days after the field came on stream and output was rising daily.
Norway's largest listed oil company began production at Vigdis on Tuesday five months ahead of schedule and 600 million crowns under budget.

The development will add at peak flow around 95,000 barrels per day (bpd) to Norwegian crude production, pumping oil to the nearby Snorre platform from where it is piped to the Gullfaks A installation for storage and export.
"Yesterday Snorre and Vigdis produced 41,000 cubic metres (257,890 barrels). It's a new record for us, but I guess we'll be setting new records every day," Saga spokesman Bjoern Schibevaag said.
Average output at Snorre is around 230,000 bpd.
